question.text: Under which SEBI regulation are promoters required to disclose details of their encumbered shares including NDUs?

answer.text: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires promoters to disclose details of their encumbered shares including NDUs. The Trap: LODR Regulations also have disclosure requirements but the specific mandate for NDU disclosure is under Takeover Regulations. Cross-Exam Context: NISM Series IX (Merchant Banking) covers the SAST Regulations in detail.
